profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend & Microservices| Java (21), Spring Boot, AWS | High-Availability Systems
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience architecting high-availability, scalable backend systems for the Financial and Logistics sectors. Expert in Java (up to 21), Spring Boot, and AWS microservices. Proven track record of modernizing legacy monoliths, dramatically reducing technical debt, and designing the robust data pipelines and cloud infrastructure required to support modern, data-intensive, and AI-driven enterprise applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Backend Developer
positions.description:
Backend development and microservices architecture for high-volume financial trade processing systems. Stack: Java 8-21, Spring Boot, AWS, Docker, Jenkins.

* Architected RESTful APIs to decouple legacy systems, successfully reducing data-exchange latency across cross-functional teams by ~70%.

* Spearheaded TDD and strategic refactoring utilizing JUnit and Mockito, decreasing code smells and reducing technical debt by ~90% (from ~7,000 to ~700 issues).

* Designed scalable Spring Boot microservices in cloud-supported environments, improving overall system scalability and accelerating release cycles.

* Modernized CI/CD workflows by containerizing applications with Docker and orchestrating deployments via Jenkins across all environments.

* Collaborated directly with Product Owners in PI Planning sessions to define technical roadmaps and delivery timelines.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Backend Developer
positions.description:
Modernization of mission-critical banking backend systems. Stack: Spring Boot, AWS (EC2, Lambda), RabbitMQ, Python.

* Spearheaded the migration of a legacy ATM backend to AWS EC2 microservices, increasing transaction processing efficiency by ~80%.

* Integrated RabbitMQ to ensure 99.9% data consistency and zero message loss across ~50K daily high-volume banking transactions.

* Orchestrated serverless workflows via AWS Lambda and Python to optimize resource allocation and reduce infrastructure overhead.

* Established monitoring pipelines via AWS CloudWatch, decreasing incident MTTR by ~90%.
Streamlined release cycles via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, cutting manual deployment times by ~90%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
High-throughput logistics and security platform engineering. Stack: Java 8, Cassandra, Docker, RabbitMQ.
Engineered backend platforms successfully processing over ~1 GB of daily transportation data with sub-second latency using Cassandra.

* Led a company-wide Docker containerization initiative, eliminating configuration drift and accelerating QA provisioning times by ~99%.

*Built and integrated RESTful Web Services utilizing RabbitMQ for real-time communication across ~100 interconnected client systems.

*Enforced strict code quality standards via SonarQube, maintaining code coverage above ~90% and significantly reducing production defects.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Enterprise integration APIs and mission-critical legacy modernization. Stack: Java 7, Oracle Database, WebLogic, SOAP.

* Architected mission-critical nationwide SOAP APIs for the SAT (DYC and DA systems), automating federal tax payments for millions of citizens.
* Engineered a bidirectional API integration for a national secure tracking system with Philip Morris International.
* Maintained and optimized legacy applications supporting critical infrastructure for the tobacco industry.

educations.schoolName: Universidad Autónoma del Estado de Hidalgo
